script: Running a freelance business needs basic structure. Check your local registration rules and open a separate bank account. Every paid job needs an invoice with a sequential number. Use a simple written agreement that covers scope, revisions, timeline, payment, ownership and cancellation. Know the licence for every template, photo and font you use. Set aside a share of every payment for tax, and confirm the amount with a local accountant. This video is general guidance, not legal or tax advice.
